 Distribution of Prot K (Qiagen)
This protocol is a translation of the attached json protocol json protocol to python with a couple additional features for control of the blow out location in order to place it near the bottom of the source well: 4 ul Prot K is distributed from a reservoir to the columns of a 96 deep-well plate with a blow out of the disposal volume occuring in a location close to the bottom of the reservoir.
The deck layout can be displayed by uploading the attached json protocol to the Opentrons Protocol Designer web page.
